title: Utility Line Protection Plans Schedule of Restoration Allowances and Repair Work Inclusions
content:
# Schedule of Restoration Allowances and Repair Work Inclusions

Claims Finance schedule for the Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans. The allowances are per-occurrence amounts in US dollars and sit within the occurrence cap; the inclusions say whether an item of work is paid or permitted on the plan.

## Allowances per occurrence

| Plan | Public way restoration allowance | Landscaping restoration allowance | Slab access allowance |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Exterior Water Service Line Plan | $2500.00 | $250.00 | $0.00 |
| Bridgewell Exterior Electrical Line Plan | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Bridgewell Exterior Sewer and Septic Line Plan | $4000.00 | $250.00 | $0.00 |
| Bridgewell Interior Plumbing and Drainage Plan | $0.00 | $0.00 | $500.00 |
| Bridgewell Water and Sewer Line Bundle | $4000.00 | $250.00 | $0.00 |
| Bridgewell Total Home Lines Plan | $4000.00 | $500.00 | $500.00 |

- **Public way restoration allowance** — the per-occurrence amount for cutting and restoring a public sidewalk, curb or street, within the occurrence cap.
- **Landscaping restoration allowance** — the per-occurrence amount for basic lawn restoration (backfill, seed and straw), within the occurrence cap.
- **Slab access allowance** — the per-occurrence amount for accessing interior lines through a slab or foundation, within the occurrence cap.

## Work inclusions (Yes means included)

| Plan | Private driveways, patios and decorative hardscape restored | Permits paid within the cap | Camera inspection paid within the cap | Sewer cleanout installation paid within the cap | Trenchless method allowed | Emergency temporary repair covered | Gas pressure test covered |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Exterior Water Service Line Plan | No | Yes | No | No | Yes | Yes | No |
| Bridgewell Exterior Electrical Line Plan | No | Yes | No | No | No | Yes | No |
| Bridgewell Exterior Sewer and Septic Line Plan | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Bridgewell Interior Plumbing and Drainage Plan | No | Yes | Yes | No | No | Yes | No |
| Bridgewell Water and Sewer Line Bundle | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Bridgewell Total Home Lines Plan | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

Column meanings: whether private driveways, patios and decorative hardscape are restored; whether permits required for a covered repair are paid within the occurrence cap; whether a camera inspection to locate a sewer or drain failure is paid within the occurrence cap; whether installing a sewer cleanout required to complete a covered repair is paid within the occurrence cap; whether the contractor may use trenchless repair or replacement; whether a temporary repair to restore service before the permanent repair is covered; whether the pressure test required after a gas line repair is covered.

## Points read from the tables

- Only the Interior Plumbing and Drainage Plan and the Total Home Lines Plan carry a slab access allowance, $500.00 on each.
- The Total Home Lines Plan's landscaping restoration allowance is $500.00; the other plans that carry one show $250.00.
- No plan restores private driveways, patios or decorative hardscape.
